This patch gives every rank a crest (an emblem in the style of League's tier crests or Valorant's rank icons) and shows it everywhere a rank appears. The text stays for screen readers and tooltips. Its placement progress shows as a ring or pips around it. - **Rotten**: a dull, bruised grape in a plain, chipped frame with muted colours. - **Normal**: a clean grape in a simple frame. - **Large**: a bigger, fuller cluster in a sturdier frame, with leaves. - **Golden**: gold metal frame, a glossy cluster, a vine flourish. - **Mythic**: a jewelled, iridescent violet cluster with wings or a halo, plus a soft glow. - **Jlorious**: the showpiece, as cool as League's Challenger or Valorant's Radiant. It has a crowned, radiant cluster, full wings, light rays and a subtle animated shimmer or glow. The animation stops under `prefers-reduced-motion`, which `index.css` already collapses. The player's position (`#7`) is printed on or under the crest. **Divisions improve the same way in every tier.** Each step from III to II to I adds the same embellishment in every tier. For example, division III has one gem or stud at the crest's base, II has two, and I has three, plus one frame upgrade at each step. Whatever the rule is, it's one rule shared by all Grape tiers, so a player can read any tier's division at a glance. Pips within a division render as a small pip bar under the crest instead of `2/4 pips`. **How to build it.** - Use one component, `apps/web/src/rank/RankCrest.tsx`, as inline SVG.
